# EmerDepot

> Canada's largest medical supply distributor offering clinical equipment, PPE, home healthcare products, and next-day delivery across Ontario and nationwide.

EmerDepot is based in Toronto, Ontario (2957 Dufferin St) and serves healthcare facilities, clinics, and home care providers with a comprehensive catalog of medical supplies from brands like Bausch + Lomb, Amsino, Terumo, Lumex, and Medicom.
